items.heading: Stewed Saltfish with Spicy Plantains
details: Key ingredients: salted codfish, tomato, onion, plantain
Soak and flake salted codfish.
Saute onion and tomato into a light sauce.
Combine the flaked fish with the sauce.
Fry spicy plantain slices and serve alongside.

items.heading: Goat Water
details: Key ingredients: goat meat, breadfruit, cassava, spices
Brown goat meat with warming spices.
Add breadfruit and cassava, then enough water to simmer.
Cook slowly until the goat meat is very tender.
Serve the thick stew as a hearty main course.
